copy.description: Building, renovations and extensions across Bomaderry and the South Coast. Owner-operated by Darryn Horgan, 35 years in the industry. New homes, extensions, renovations, outdoor living and granny flats.
copy.headline:
Built by the man
who quotes it.
copy.sub: Building, renovations and extensions. Darryn Horgan has been in the industry 35 years and owner-operated for 23 of them, so the person who prices your job is the person on site.
copy.statementBody: Twenty-three years running his own business, and thirty-five in the industry before and during it. There is no site manager between you and the person doing the work.
copy.servicesIntro: Job size ranges from three skylights in a hallway to a full storm-damage rebuild — Darryn takes it on either way.
copy.workIntro: Recent jobs across Bomaderry and the South Coast, including a storm-damage rebuild and a client HBR has worked with for over 20 years.
copy.areasIntro: Based in Bomaderry, working across the surrounding areas.
copy.enquireIntro: Darryn reads every enquiry. The more you can tell us about the property and what you want from it, the more useful the first conversation will be.

serviceAreas._source: Their site only names Bomaderry by address and says 'Bomaderry and surrounding areas' on every page (home, extensions, renovations, outdoor-living pages); no suburb list is published. These eight are the real nearby suburbs within the City of Shoalhaven / South Coast, all within about 15km of Bomaderry (Bomaderry sits on the Shoalhaven River opposite Nowra, with North Nowra directly adjacent). Confirmed against public geographic reference, not against the client's own wording — worth a quick confirm with Darryn on the call that this is in fact his working radius.

credentials.label: Owner-operated for 23 years
credentials._source: "...23 years running our owner-operated business, Darryn Horgan delivers hands-on support..." — https://www.horganbuildingandrenovations.com.au/ (About text). Kept as a duration rather than 'since 2003': that year is nowhere on their site, only the 23-year figure is, and printing an invented founding year is exactly the kind of unsourced fact the gate blocks.

credentials.label: 35 years in the industry
credentials._source: "With over 35 years of experience in the building industry..." — https://www.horganbuildingandrenovations.com.au/ (About text). Not a contradiction with the 23-years-owner-operated figure: 35 years total experience minus 23 years running his own business leaves about 12 years working in the trade before he went out on his own, which is ordinary for a builder.

reviews.name: anna smallwood
reviews.text: We had such a positive experience working with Darryn. The entire build was smooth from start to finish, with no issues at all. His workmanship was excellent, and the end result exceeded our expectations. Darryn was reliable, professional, and a pleasure to work with. We couldn’t be happier with the outcome and highly recommend him.

reviews.name: Margaret Dickinson
reviews.text: The difference three skylights have made to our dull hallway and family room is truly amazing. We were so pleased with the professional approach, quality and efficiency of workmanship that Darryn and his team displayed that we wholeheartedly recommend them. It was a pleasure to deal with Darryn on every level.

reviews.name: Matt Barnett
reviews.text: Darryn and his team did a fantastic job renovating our home. They completed all aspects of the indoor and outdoor work efficiently and with great skill. Darryn is a fantastic problem solver!! Many times his ideas saved us time and cost.

reviews.name: peter maher
reviews.text: We first engaged Darryn and Horgan Building and Renovations (HBR) soon after moving down from Sydney. We experienced some damage to our house following a storm in April of 2022.

reviews.name: Sue Cuninghame
reviews.text: Darryn and his team are outstanding. We have used HBR over the past 20 years and have always found them to be incredibly professional, trustworthy and skilful.

owner.body: Owner-operator. Thirty-five years in the building industry, twenty-three of them running this business, which means the person who quotes your job is the person who turns up to build it.

process.detail: A few details and a photo or two is enough to start. Darryn will tell you straight away if it is something he takes on.
Measurements, access and what you actually want, then a detailed, no-obligation quote with the inclusions spelled out.
You pick a start date. The same person who quoted it runs the site.

faq.q: Who will actually be on site?
faq.a: Darryn. He has been owner-operated for twenty-three years, which is the whole point — you are not handed to a site manager after you sign.

faq.q: How much does an extension cost?
faq.a: It depends on size, access and how much of the existing house gets touched. We give you a real number after seeing it, not a per-square-metre guess over the phone.
Yes. Design, drawings and the certifier are part of the job, so you are not chasing paperwork.

faq.q: Can we live in the house during the build?
faq.a: Often yes, depending on what is being touched. We will be straight with you about what it will be like.
In writing, priced, and approved by you before the work happens. No surprises on the final invoice.
